name: Sai
collateral_and_settlement: USDC / stNIBI supported; self-custodied; gasless trading (bridge gas still possible)
funding_model: OI-imbalance borrowing fee charged to crowded side; not necessarily paid to opposite-side traders
fee_mechanism: 0.05% base taker; 0% maker; 0.01% trigger; additional decaying rapid-close fee applies to very short holds
risk_focus: Oracle integrity, pool solvency, dynamic leverage and rapid-close costs
caveat: Fee schedule and protected market parameters can change; no direct performance claim.

name: Hyperliquid
liquidity: Resting maker orders and market makers
funding_model: Perpetual funding payments for spot-price convergence
fee_mechanism: Order book spread and maker/taker economics (rates excluded pending fee-tier snapshot)
risk_focus: Order-book depth, market-maker concentration, oracle/mark and margining
caveat: Order-book state may diverge from quoted liquidity under stress; effective fees vary by account tier.

name: GMX
collateral_and_settlement: Liquidity pools back trader profits and losses
fee_mechanism: Published open/close fees and separate open-interest-imbalance price impact, borrowing and network fees
risk_focus: Pool PnL limits, utilization and withdrawal constraints
caveat: Fee and price impact vary by market, position and conditions.

name: dYdX Chain
execution: Validator-maintained in-memory order books with block matching
collateral_and_settlement: Cosmos SDK application-chain software; validator consensus
funding_model: Perpetual market funding (specific rate formulas not compared)
fee_mechanism: Order book / maker-taker design; absolute rates excluded pending current protocol snapshot
risk_focus: Order dissemination, mempool latency, consensus, liquidations
caveat: Documentation applies to dYdX Chain software; deployed instances can vary.
